summary: Learn the art of leading virtual meetings with our tailored course. Gain essential skills for successful video conferences and effective team collaboration.
lede: Virtual meeting leadership training covers planning and facilitating focused online and hybrid sessions. For professionals leading distributed teams, it develops practical skills in shaping agendas, setting up breakout activities, and encouraging participation through polls, chat, and shared whiteboards. Participants also explore managing hybrid dynamics, securing meetings, and using transcription tools to capture decisions and track action items.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals who lead distributed teams and must maintain high levels of productivity and engagement in a virtual or hybrid setting.
modules: Foundations of Virtual Presence and Digital Authority
Strategic Agenda Design for Digital Environments
Managing Difficult Dynamics and Hybrid Challenges
AI Integration and Automated Meeting Workflows
Synthesis: The Master Facilitator’s Action Plan
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational familiarity with at least one major video conferencing platform (Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or Google Meet). Access to a computer with a working camera and microphone is required for the practical exercises. No prior facilitation experience is necessary, though a current role involving team coordination is recommended.
